Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner turn after the initial setup), the Planner incorrectly identified the death date of James Kirkwood as April 21, 1989. This date corresponds to James Kirkwood Jr. (the Pulitzer Prize-winning playwright of *A Chorus Line*), not James Kirkwood Sr., the silent film director of *A Dream Or Two Ago*. The correct death date for James Kirkwood Sr. is August 24, 1963. This initial factual error propagated through the rest of the conversation, leading to an incorrect final comparison.
